method: Native PNG inspection, no image manipulation. Controlled neutral full-body/head and actual action/gameplay images; compared immutable pre-paint full front/rear/head rear/gameplay source images.

identity_retained: Continuous purple visor without twin bright columns or W-shaped central split
Olive crown, thin blue brow, short solid green chin and side vents retained
U chest frame and large green/silver-blue panel layout retained
surface_improvement: Knee/shin pale crack lines reduced into broad matte plane highlights
Arm rim/green panel thin edging reduced to restrained corner wear
Shoulder scratch/outline contrast reduced and broad blue highlight retained
remaining: Head brow/chin and chest U-frame still have comparatively bright edge treatment: conservative first painting pass, further art review needed
Rear crown original central fine slit remains from accepted pre-paint design; this pass does not modify its geometry or UVs
Major shoulder/body silhouette and rear layout intentionally remain locked; this pass alone does not establish a distinct new armor identity

limits: Subjective art inspection only; no blind player study, quantified style-similarity score, all-frame motion certification or PBR-material test.
